layers.name: Zcash
layers.how: Shielded transactions use zero-knowledge proofs to hide the sender, the receiver and the amount.

layers.name: Monero
layers.how: Private by default: ring signatures hide the sender, stealth addresses hide the receiver, and amounts are confidential.

layers.name: Pirate Chain
layers.how: Every transaction is shielded with zero-knowledge proofs. There are no transparent addresses.

layers.name: Firo
layers.how: The Spark protocol hides the sender, the receiver and the amount.

layers.name: Zano
layers.how: Ring signatures and stealth addresses, with private assets issued on the chain.

layers.name: Dero
layers.how: Balances stay encrypted on the chain, and smart contracts run privately.

layers.name: Beam
layers.how: Mimblewimble: no addresses and no amounts are written to the chain.

layers.name: Grin
layers.how: Mimblewimble: no addresses and no amounts are written to the chain.

layers.name: Dash
layers.how: Optional CoinJoin mixing breaks the link between where coins came from and where they go.

layers.name: Litecoin MWEB
layers.how: MWEB is Litecoin's opt-in privacy layer: Mimblewimble extension blocks hide amounts.

layers.name: Verge
layers.how: Wallet traffic goes through Tor, and stealth addresses hide the receiver.

layers.name: MobileCoin
layers.how: Private payments built for phones, with hidden senders, receivers and amounts.

layers.name: Secret Network
layers.how: Secret contracts compute on encrypted data inside secure enclaves.

layers.name: Oasis
layers.how: Sapphire keeps smart-contract state and calldata encrypted.

layers.name: Aleo
layers.how: Applications run off-chain and prove their results with zero-knowledge proofs, so inputs stay private.

layers.name: Namada
layers.how: One shared shielded pool for many assets, so every shielded asset hides in the same crowd.

layers.name: Penumbra
layers.how: A shielded chain: transfers, staking and swaps are private.

layers.name: Iron Fish
layers.how: Every transaction is private by default, using zero-knowledge proofs.

layers.name: Dusk
layers.how: Zero-knowledge privacy built for regulated finance.

layers.name: Horizen
layers.how: Started as a Zcash fork; now builds privacy apps and zero-knowledge tooling.

layers.name: Aztec
layers.how: A private-by-default layer 2 on Ethereum.

layers.name: Railgun
layers.how: Shielded balances and private DeFi on EVM chains, using zero-knowledge proofs.

layers.name: Panther
layers.how: Shielded pools for private DeFi.

layers.name: Umbra
layers.how: Private transfers and swaps on Solana.

layers.name: Nym
layers.how: A mixnet: traffic is shuffled and padded so nobody can see who talks to whom.

layers.name: Phala
layers.how: Confidential computing inside secure enclaves.

layers.name: Nillion
layers.how: Blind computation: data stays secret while it is being used.

layers.name: Zama
layers.how: Fully homomorphic encryption: computing on data that is never decrypted.

layers.name: Mind Network
layers.how: Fully homomorphic encryption for AI agents and cross-chain messages.

layers.name: Arcium
layers.how: Encrypted computation for Solana apps.

layers.name: Privacy Pools
layers.how: Private withdrawals that prove the funds are not from a flagged set.
